bug_semantics: FluentCMS 1.2.3's TextHTML plugin renders stored HTML content directly as raw markup: TextHTMLViewPlugin.razor contains `@((MarkupString)Item.Content)` (originally `@((MarkupString)Content.Content)`), and the edit flow accepts arbitrary HTML from authenticated editors with no sanitization anywhere in the plugin. An attacker with content-editing privileges (or via stored-content injection) can persist JavaScript that executes in every visitor's browser — stored XSS (CWE-79).
flaw_origin: Commit 876447765cf2d2bd47cf0a0fa1f62013f784ef91 ("#1781 implement texthtml plugin (#1784)", 2024-07-07, author Hadi Ahmadi <TheHadiAhmadi@gmail.com>, committer GitHub) created the TextHTML plugin including TextHTMLViewPlugin.razor with the raw `@((MarkupString)Content.Content)` render and no HtmlSanitizer usage; the parent tree 10a37a9751260abb2955a9fbff830a889d972897 has no TextHTML plugin directory (only FluentCMS.Web.Plugins.Admin under src/Frontend/Plugins), so the BIC introduced the unsanitized render path. The flawed pattern survived refactors (a1d52ef45b92 2024-11-14 namespace move, 5c109ea62955 2024-11-29 restructure) until the 2026 fix.
